svg.title: Check-ins and assessments
svg.desc: 3 English interface examples. From a few setup questions that only shape what the app suggests, through a daily check-in, a gifts inventory and a church survey, to a spiritual score as a warning case: decide what each question is for, what is kept, who sees a result, and how much the result claims to know.

g.text: BIBLE AND FAITH APP DESIGN PATTERNS
Check-ins and assessments
From a few setup questions that only shape what the app suggests, through a daily check-in, a gifts inventory and a church
survey, to a spiritual score as a warning case: decide what each question is for, what is kept, who sees a result, and how
much the result claims to know.
A · Setup questions
PRACTICE · EXAMPLE
How familiar is the Bible to
you?
This changes: how much background each
reading includes.
B · Daily check-in
PRACTICE · EXAMPLE
How are you, today?
Anxious · Tired · Grateful
C · Gifts inventory
PRACTICE · EXAMPLE
Places to explore
Welcome and care · Try: the Sunday
welcome team
A few optional questions, each saying what
it changes.
Name a feeling; get a passage, not a score.
Statements about oneself; places to try.
SCHEMATIC TEXT ROWS, NOT LOADING STATES · ORIGINAL PROPOSALS · NOT PRODUCT SCREENSHOTS

Anonymous answers, shared results by area.
A number, a stage and a rank.
